dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So the Dornman Port belongs to the Gunnhildr Clan?

dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: No. After Vennessa's uprising, the Gunnhildr Clan led a push to abolish all hereditary noble fiefdoms, returning both the land and their freedom to the people of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: Look at the present day. The once-mighty Imunlaukr Clan has seen its bloodline vanish, and their accomplices have long since lost their former prominence.

dialogues.speaker: Hannelore
dialogues.text: Time eventually erodes all mighty powers with no partiality, and only the wind continues to blow as it always has. This is also a blessing from Lord Barbatos.
